operatorInputs.validation: Non-empty label; letters, digits, spaces, and hyphens.

prepSteps.title: Create the entro-policy ACL
prepSteps.instruction: In Vault, add an ACL policy named entro-policy with Entro's documented list/read capabilities (no write on secrets).

prepSteps.title: Create a renewable token
prepSteps.instruction: After local `vault login`, create a token bound to entro-policy and store it in the operator vault. Do not paste the token into chat.
prepSteps.evidence: Vault reports a token created with policy entro-policy (value stored outside the session)

typedActions.mutation: vault policy write entro-policy <entro-acl.hcl> with list/read capabilities from Entro's guide
typedActions.rollbackOrImpact: vault policy delete entro-policy if this run created it

typedActions.preview: Platform has no dry-run for this change; disclosed as no-preview.
typedActions.mutation: vault token create -policy=entro-policy -renewable (operator copies token into the operator vault; not into chat)
typedActions.expectedChange: Vault reports a token created with policy entro-policy (value stored outside the session)
typedActions.verification: vault token lookup (metadata only; do not print the token)
typedActions.rollbackOrImpact: vault token revoke <tokenAccessor> using the accessor, not the secret token in session
